pos.personaBrief: Sao Paulo 2006-09 was described as compact, obedient and built on the best defence (19 goals conceded in 2007); possession is undocumented for the spell, and the side leaned on counter-attacks and Ceni.

pro.personaBrief: A pragmatic, obedient side with a sweeper-keeper Ceni; direct and safe play fits the Trivela note that the team changed its way of playing when a reference striker (Adriano) arrived.

est.personaBrief: Obedient, tactically disciplined team where players know their functions (nsctotal 2006, Jornal de Brasilia 2008 on tactical and technical duties).

lar.personaBrief: The lineup (Gazeta SP) shows no wingers: two defensive midfielders, a flat midfield and a reference striker; Trivela 2008 notes a lack of full-backs, so the play was central.

blo.personaBrief: Marked hard in all sectors with forwards working up front (DOL 2018), but the team waited and countered in a compact block; no modern pressing is documented.

mar.personaBrief: In 2006 the team marked individually and Muricy only considered moving to zonal marking against aerial balls (Jornal de Brasilia 2006); he studies the opponent's key players closely (2008).

pla.personaBrief: He studied opponents in detail (radiografia do Chivas, 2006; instructing the centre-back on the rival's strong foot, 2008) and changed the system with the squad available (Trivela 2008, DOL 2008).

res.personaBrief: Three league titles with the best defence, tactical obedience and a late title charge in 2008; the criticism of his methods and his focus on winning point to results over spectacle.

sis.personaBrief: Obedience, function and harmony came before individual freedom (nsctotal 2006, Jornal de Brasilia 2008), though he backed stars like Ceni and Aloisio.

jog.personaBrief: Strong marking, a hard-working midfield pair (Josue, Mineiro, then Jean and Hernanes) and a defensive base, with little evidence of a classic number 10.

bas.personaBrief: A title side of veterans and leaders (Ceni, Aloisio, Souza, Leandro) that he kept through setbacks; modest investment and little emphasis on academy graduates.

lid.personaBrief: A united and harmonious group (Trivela 2008, nsctotal 2006), with firm control and the same rules for all, and he backed his players (Aloisio, Ceni).
